name: cache-meter
description: How well the session uses the prompt cache, and a compact button when compacting is cheaper than carrying the context

autoCompact.title: Auto compact
autoCompact.description: off: never. idle: only when you are away and the cache is about to expire. always: whenever compacting is recommended and the session is idle.

horizonTurns.title: Expected remaining turns
horizonTurns.description: How many more turns you expect in this conversation; the cost comparison runs over this many.

minContextTokens.title: Minimum context to suggest compact
minContextTokens.description: Compaction is not suggested below this context size, in tokens.

minSavingTokens.title: Minimum saving to suggest compact
minSavingTokens.description: Compaction is suggested only when it saves at least this many input-token equivalents.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: auto infers it from your plan and from what the cache did; set 5m or 1h to force it.

inputUsdPerMTok.title: Input price (USD per million tokens)
inputUsdPerMTok.description: Your model's base input price, to show savings in dollars too. 0 shows tokens only.
